name: megapowers
description: One native-first workflow plugin for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: megapowers
plugins.description: 16 task skills (plan, TDD, debug, verify, safe effects, cross-provider review, orchestration), a concise optional output style, a destructive-command tripwire, and a doctor for self-diagnosis. Uses native agents, goals, and permissions; about 1.5k always-loaded tokens.
